assetActions.reason: Defines Lokr as a private self-hosted job-search workspace and sets honest AI boundaries.
Contains the implemented Achromatic ledger tokens, flat surfaces, typography roles, and motion timings.
Loads verified local Geist and Geist Mono fonts.
Provides the Lokr mark, labelled navigation shell, English copy, and local interaction model.
Verified local monospace font for non-sensitive IDs and keys.
User-supplied reference for the connected workflow screens.
Keep the existing document-corner symbol without inventing a logo file.

lockedDecisions: Lokr remains a private self-hosted workspace for one job seeker.
All visible application copy is English.
Geist is the interface face. Geist Mono is reserved for non-sensitive IDs and keys.
Chrome remains achromatic. Blue #1d5fbf is reserved for primary data marks.
The existing labelled open-plane sidebar remains because it serves six named destinations.
The main action is adding or saving a job. Primary actions are near-black.
AI matching is a heuristic estimate only and requires explicit user action, a named provider, and data-sharing disclosure.
The interface must not imply unsupported API-key, runner, export, recording, sync, or persistence capabilities.
Illustrative jobs, companies, dates, and scores remain labelled as sample data.
assumptions: The wireframe is a workflow and desktop-layout reference, not a source for factual sample names or unsafe configuration controls.
The implemented labelled sidebar takes precedence over the sheet icon rail because it is an established shell with six destinations.
The single blue chart hue is Lokr's visual face.
No decorative imagery is needed because documents, jobs, and application trails are the product's meaningful visual material.

creativeDirection.summary: Lokr is a calm, inspectable job-search ledger. Its face is blue #1d5fbf on the active application-stage data mark, while documents, counts, navigation, and actions remain neutral. Its first question is: what job-search work should I continue now?

traits.boundary: not an interface that implies hidden AI processing or cloud sync
not a sparse shell that hides the next task

creativeDirection.productiveTension: A restrained ledger surface makes the relationship between a job, CV version, application stage, and interview preparation carry the product identity.

signatureDevice.description: The Lokr application trail, a compact sequence linking a job, the linked CV version, and the application stage.
invariants: The order is always job, CV version, then application stage.
Each part uses real local data or visibly labelled sample data.
An unlinked CV is written as Not linked.
Stage labels are always written as text and never depend on colour alone.
The trail can wrap on mobile while retaining its order.

creativeDirection.restraint: Keep coloured pixels below 1%. Blue belongs to the selected pipeline mark or other primary data mark. Green, red, and amber appear only on small meaningful status signals. Cards, navigation, and resting controls stay neutral and flat.
avoid: Tinted KPI cards or icon boxes
Gradients, glows, glass effects, and resting shadows
Rainbow charts or stage colours by category
Decorative stock photography, fictional portraits, and employer logos
Emoji, generic marketing greetings, and unsupported success claims

roles: non-sensitive object IDs and keys only

interfaceDirection: Use the established open-plane shell: a labelled 256px sidebar on the page ground, with the Lokr document-corner mark and product name at the top, six English destinations, settings and local-owner context at the bottom, and a full-screen mobile navigation sheet. Keep sparse density with a 12px grid gap, 24px canvas and card padding, 44px data rows, and 36px visual controls inside 44px touch targets. Use one muted 12px sentence-case label style, 14px body text, 16px section headings, and 24px page titles. Tables use quiet rules, no zebra bands, and right-aligned tabular figures. Statuses use neutral stage pills by default and semantic pill pairs only for meaningful contextual signals. Hover uses raised, selected uses neutral active fill, focus uses a 2px near-black outline, and disabled controls remain legible with an explanation.

buttons.primary: One near-black primary action, such as Add job, at 36px visual height with white 14px/500 text and a 6px radius. Its interactive hit area is at least 44px.
buttons.secondary: One neutral secondary action at 36px visual height with #e5e5e5 fill, 1px #d4d4d4 border, #0a0a0a 14px/500 text, and a 999px pill radius. Its interactive hit area is at least 44px.

designTokens.surfaces: Use off-white #f8f8f8 ground and sidebar, white #ffffff cards and inputs, 1px #e6e6e6 card borders, and #f0f0f0 row rules. Resting surfaces cast no shadow.

imageDirection.summary: Lokr does not need imagery. Its meaningful visual material is text-based: job titles, CV filenames, document excerpts, application trails, stage marks, and dates.
imageDirection.treatment: Use the existing outline icon set only as a direct affordance in navigation and controls. Use the Lokr document-corner mark as a simple neutral symbol.
avoid: Image-based charts or document previews that imply private-file content

motionDirection.summary: Motion is functional feedback only, using 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion reaches the same final states immediately.
principles: Navigation and menu trigger; active route and mobile navigation-sheet relationship; 180ms; interruptible ease-out.
Filter, sorting, and search trigger; stable application rows and result-count relationship; 180ms; interruptible ease-out.
Stage selection or board-status change trigger; selected control, pipeline mark, and related application-data relationship; 180ms; interruptible ease-out.
Dialog, detail pane, and drawer trigger; invoking control, focus target, and returned-focus relationship; 180ms; interruptible ease-out.
Save, review, and note actions trigger; changed local object and quiet success-message relationship; 180ms; interruptible ease-out.
Reduced-motion preference trigger; all navigation, filtering, panel, and chart-state relationships; 0ms; immediate final state.
avoid: Animated chart scales that obscure comparison
Feedback before a local state change succeeds

voice.summary: Use direct English language for job-search work. Name the object and next action: Add job, Save job, Upload CV, Review extraction, Continue draft, Change stage, Prepare interview, and Save note. State limitations plainly: Sample data, Not linked, Text not extracted, AI is not configured, No data is sent to a provider, and Analysis requires your explicit action.
avoid: Generic labels such as Items, Records, or Status
Claims of ATS scoring, hiring likelihood, or automated applications
Success messages before the action succeeds
Fake provider availability or connection claims
